firm_data.firm_description: Larimer Law delivers legal services, consulting solutions, and thought leadership in eDiscovery, information governance and data privacy law. With offices in Rochester and Buffalo, New York, they serve corporate clients and law firms of all sizes and from a wide range of US and International jurisdictions.
notable_facts: Larimer Law has a sister company, Guru Discovery, for data processing and analytics services.
Larimer Law is known for its ability to scale teams to meet project needs.
technology_signals: Expertise in electronic discovery and document review services
Experience with Global Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

additional_contacts.name: Lawrence Bice
additional_contacts.title: Sr. Counsel & Director of Litigation Services

email.subject: AI for Larimer Law, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi John,

Your work in eDiscovery and data retention forensics puts Larimer Law at the intersection of where AI is creating the biggest competitive advantage right now. With Guru Discovery handling data processing, you're already positioned to scale efficiently, but the document analysis and discovery workflows are still where most firms leave money on the table.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Rochester to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on discovery speed and accuracy.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
